alina: Quick RFC follow-up: we're exploring adaptive sampling at the network edge to cut ingest cost. Main ask: how does this interact with cost attribution and billing-key propagation? Need a short decision thread.

marco: Adaptive sampling reduces token volume but breaks naive per-request cost attribution if we drop sampled spans before adding billing metadata. We must ensure billing_key is copied to any emitted sample or sampling decision happens after billing attach.

devin: Two patterns: 1) attach billing_key upstream (producer) so samples still carry it; 2) sampling at ingress after enrichment so every sampled trace has billing metadata. Option 1 shifts trust to producers. Option 2 increases ingest work.

alina: Our producers are heterogeneous; can't rely on all of them to attach billing fields. So leaning to attach-at-ingress then sample. That keeps billing correctness but reduces savings.

marco: Compromise: do a two-step flow — cheap pre-filter at edge (drop obviously noisy telemetry) then full enrich+sample at regional ingress. Pre-filter rules must be conservative and never drop traces missing billing metadata.

devin: We also need to surface sampling decision in downstream envelopes: add header sample_reason and sample_version so billing pipelines can reverse-synthesize counts. For non-sampled requests we emit a light-count envelope (no full trace) containing billing_key and weight=1 to preserve aggregate counts.

alina: Good call. That weight envelope is key for accurate cost attribution without full payload. Define schema: {billing_key, reason, weight, ts, producer_id}. Keep it tiny.

ops-bot: Note: feature flag safe-deploy sampling.alpha enabled on ingest canary.

marco: Acceptance criteria for canary: aggregated billing totals for canary segment within 0.2% of baseline after accounting for weights; sampled trace retention meets SLOs; p50 ingest CPU < +6%.

devin: Action items: marco draft pre-filter rule whitelist (no billing fields dropped), alina implement lightweight weight-envelope emitter, i'll wire sample_reason header and metrics. I'll open tickets.

alina: I'll schedule a 30m sync to align metrics for billing pipelines. Closing thread for now.
